question: Which of the following has now got the status of a full-fledged state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sikkim** was granted the status of a full-fledged state of India on **16th May 1975**.
 
• Sikkim became the 22nd state of India after the **36th Amendment** to the Constitution of India.
 
• Prior to becoming a state, Sikkim was an Indian protectorate, meaning it was under the protection and partial control of India but was not fully integrated.
 
• The transition to statehood was a result of a referendum held in Sikkim, where the majority of the population voted in favor of joining India as a state.
 
• Sikkim is known for its **unique cultural heritage** and **scenic beauty**, attracting tourists from around the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chandigarh** is a Union Territory and the capital of both Punjab and Haryana.
 
• **Pondicherry** (now Puducherry) is a Union Territory with special administrative status.
 
• **Lakshadweep** is a Union Territory comprising a group of islands in the Arabian Sea.
 
• The status of these regions as Union Territories means they are directly governed by the Central Government of India.
 
• The constitutional amendment process for integrating new states is outlined in **Article 2 and Article 3** of the Indian Constitution.
